title: SALOLAND
body:
**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1  
**Loader:** NeoForge  
**Recommended RAM:** 4–6 GB  

---

**🚀 Core Concept**
This modpack expands vanilla survival by integrating complex mechanical engineering and functional aircraft.

---

### Gameplay Features

**🔧 Technology & Engineering**
* Provides a robust system for building intricate mechanical contraptions and fully controllable flying vehicles.

**🌍 Exploration & Dimensions**
* Adds **three distinct moons** (Mining, Peaceful, and End-themed). Each moon features unique environmental effects. For example, on the peaceful moon, hostile mobs will not appear at night.

**⚔️ Combat & Bosses**
* Expands the hostile mob roster with new enemies and formidable **bosses** that require tactical gameplay to defeat.

---

### Multiplayer Experience
* Optimized for **small group servers (2–6 players)**.

---

### Performance & Optimization
The pack is pre-configured with a suite of performance mods designed to:
* Maximize **FPS** and smoothness.
* Reduce CPU and GPU load significantly.
* Optimize memory usage and accelerate world generation.

---

### User Interface & Quality of Life
* Enhanced main menu and custom interface elements.
* Intuitive inventory sorting, recipe lookup tools, and a minimap/world map.
* Various visual and audio adjustments for improved immersion.

---

### Note
This pack is designed for long-term playthroughs focusing on technological progression and creative base-building. It includes additional content mods that alter mob behaviors and visual appearances.
